About Sarvam
Sarvam is building the bedrock of sovereign AI for India. We are developing India's full-stack AI platform across research, models, infrastructure and applications, with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India: in Indian languages, on Indian data and at Indian scale.
Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC and LIC, alongside central and state governments. Sarvam is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV and Khosla Ventures.

About the Team
Deployment Strategy is the team that takes Sarvam from a promising pilot to AI in production inside India's largest and most consequential organisations: banks, insurers, manufacturers, and central and state governments.
The team is organised as vertical pods (BFSI; Industrials, Manufacturing & Digital Natives; State Government; Central Government). Each pod owns its accounts end to end and works alongside Sales, Engineering, Product and our partner ecosystem to turn AI capability into deployed systems that create measurable value.

About the Role
As a Deployment Strategist II, you will own multiple accounts and run several end-to-end engagements at the same time. You will be the client's day-to-day thought partner, the person who turns a business problem into a deployed AI system, and the person who grows the account from there.
You will lead DS-1s and partner teams on your engagements, and you will be accountable for deployments going live and delivering the value we committed to.

Why This Role Matters
This is one of the most consequential client-facing roles in Indian AI. You will work as a thought partner to client CXOs and senior government leaders, shaping how the largest and most consequential organisations in India adopt AI.
You will shape the entire deployment strategy: from the business case, to the use cases, to the ROI, to the engineering and product build that makes it real. The role sits at the intersection of consulting, product and technology. You bring the structure of a consultant, the judgement of a product manager and the rigour of an engineer, and you apply all three to the same account at the same time.
Above all, this role needs complete ownership. You take the client's outcome as your own, not just your part of it. You take an ambiguous problem, give it structure and carry it to a result, going broad enough to see where the most important problems lie and deep enough on the ones that matter to own their outcome, and pulling in the right people inside and outside Sarvam to get it done.

What You'll Do
• 
Own multiple accounts and run several end-to-end engagements at once, from discovery to production.
• 
Work as a thought partner to client CXOs and business heads, shaping how their organisation adopts AI.
• 
Lead discovery with business and technology teams, and turn pain points into problem statements and use cases with real ROI.
• 
Build the business case and success metrics with the client, articulate why Sarvam, and work with Sales on expansion.
• 
Shape the solution with Engineering and Product, and build demos and quick prototypes yourself.
• 
Run the deployment: plan the programme, manage risks and dependencies, and lead DS-1s and partner or SI teams.
• 
Drive adoption with the people who use the system every day, and hit the KPIs we committed to.
• 
Shape strategy by bringing market feedback back into Sarvam's product prioritisation.
• 
Write the playbooks that make the next deployment faster.
Must Haves
• 
6+ years of experience. An engineering undergraduate degree is preferred.
• 
3+ years in customer-facing roles such as management consulting, forward deployed engineering or strategy, technical consulting or product management.
• 
A track record of owning multiple client engagements against a date and a number, and of managing sub-teams or partner teams.
• 
Fluency in APIs, integrations, data flows, LLM behaviour, prompts and evaluations, with the ability to diagnose why an agent is failing rather than simply escalating it.
• 
Strong communication, structured problem solving and business acumen.
• 
Willingness to be based in the listed city and to travel 25-50% of the time.
Good to Haves
• 
An MBA from a leading institution.
• 
Experience shipping LLM agents to production.
• 
Depth in the vertical. For BFSI, this includes collections, onboarding, servicing or claims, and RBI or IRDAI compliance. For Industrials, Manufacturing & Digital Natives, this includes dealer, service, supply chain or contact centre workflows. For State Government, this includes department workflows, e-governance and public procurement.
• 
Proficiency in a regional language, particularly for State Government roles.
• 
Startup or founder experience.

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.
The Team: 

Unsecured Installments is one of Upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. The team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers Upstart at scale. Recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer-facing experience.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Unsecured Installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly. Working primarily in React and TypeScript, you'll own the delivery of large, multi-month projects, shape the architecture of the team's mobile-web and full-stack surfaces, and set a high bar for quality across the borrower experience. You'll partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to turn ambiguous problems into durable, well-architected solutions, and you'll mentor other engineers along the way.

How you’ll make an impact

• 

Own the design and delivery of large, complex frontend initiatives using React and TypeScript, from planning and sequencing through launch and long-term maintenance.

• 

Set technical direction for the team's frontend architecture, owning a 3–6 month roadmap and proactively addressing systemic gaps that threaten team effectiveness.

• 

Partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to translate roadmap priorities and borrower needs into scalable, high-quality experiences.

• 

Raise the bar for engineering excellence through strong component and API design, thoughtful state management, testing, observability, and operational rigor across borrower-facing surfaces.

• 

Lead through ambiguity, breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs on scope, performance, and user experience.

• 

Mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team.

• 

Contribute to how the team uses AI in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage.

Minimum Qualifications 

• 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

• 

Deep proficiency building complex web applications with React and TypeScript, including component architecture, state management, performance optimization, and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs.

• 

Track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business-critical frontend projects in production.

• 

Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time.

• 

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and align product, design, and engineering partners.

Preferred Qualifications

• 

Experience building consumer-facing products at scale with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and user experience.

• 

Background in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products with complex user journeys and high quality expectations.

• 

Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flagging to drive iterative product improvements in production.

• 

Familiarity with modern frontend tooling and testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress) and CI/CD workflows.

• 

Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI in product features or internal engineering workflows.

• 

Passion for building products that expand access to credit and improve financial outcomes for consumers.

What is SeekOut?   

SeekOut is a leader in AI-driven talent optimization, helping organizations recruit, reskill, and redeploy talent with AI-driven solutions. SeekOut transforms how companies build winning teams by empowering organizations to align talent strategy with business strategy via breakthrough agentic AI solutions. Our software and services help companies ensure that they hire the right people and match their talent to the highest-impact roles to drive business success.   

What are we looking to add to our team?

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer who is deeply creative, visually opinionated, and energized by hard, undefined problems. This role is for a designer who thinks beyond patterns, challenges conventions, and takes pride in exceptional craft. You are bold in your ideas, brave in your execution, and uncompromising when it comes to visual quality. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast without losing taste, and believe great design should feel intentional, surprising, and deeply human. 

What you’ll be doing:

• Invent the future of AI recruiting. Design precedent-setting AI and ML-driven product experiences where there is no established playbook, balancing usability, trust, and delight. 

• Create bold 0→1 experiences. Explore new interaction models, visual languages, and product concepts that push beyond conventional enterprise UX. 

• Design with taste and intention. Produce high-craft, polished design work across flows, surfaces, and systems with a strong point of view on visual quality. 

• Rapidly iterate and refine. Generate, test, and evolve ideas quickly, moving from rough concepts to confident solutions with speed and clarity. 

• Tell compelling product stories. Use visuals, prototypes, and narrative to clearly communicate the intent, emotion, and experience behind your designs. 

• Make it real. Translate conceptual thinking into production-ready designs that engineers can build and users can immediately understand. 

• Build and extend design systems. Contribute to scalable, well-structured design systems that enable fast iteration while maintaining a high visual bar. 

• Leverage modern design tools. Work fluently in Figma, using components, variables, auto-layout, and prototyping to move efficiently from idea to execution. 

• Experiment with generative AI. Use generative AI tools to explore concepts, accelerate ideation, and push creative boundaries in how products are imagined and designed. 

• Stay curious and experimental. Continuously explore emerging AI capabilities, interaction paradigms, and visual trends to keep SeekOut’s products modern and distinctive. 

What you’ll accomplish in your first 6–12 months:

• Deliver standout, high-impact 0→1 designs for new AI-driven recruiting and talent products. 

• Raise the visual and experiential bar on the product surfaces you own.

• Ship designs that meaningfully improve clarity, trust, and delight in complex workflows. 

• Demonstrate rapid iteration cycles that balance speed, exploration, and exceptional craft. 

What you’ll bring to the team:

• 5+ years of experience designing and shipping high-quality product experiences in SaaS, enterprise, or AI-driven software. 

• Proven success delivering 0→1 products or features in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. 

• Exceptional visual design skills, with a sharp eye for layout, typography, motion, and interaction detail. 

• High proficiency in Figma, including advanced use of components, variables, auto-layout, prototyping, and design systems. 

• Deep experience working within and extending design systems without sacrificing creativity or quality. 

• Strong ability to rapidly iterate, explore multiple directions, and converge on high-confidence solutions. 

• Experience using generative AI design tools as part of the creative process is a major plus. 

• Comfort challenging assumptions and proposing unconventional solutions when the problem demands it. 

• A deep passion for craft, aesthetics, and pushing quality beyond “good enough.” 

• A portfolio that clearly demonstrates creative range, bold thinking, rapid iteration, and outstanding execution across real products. 

A design portfolio is a requirement to be considered for this role.  To confirm you’ve read this posting, enter the word LIGHTHOUSE in the question at the end of the application.

Our Commitment to Pay Fairness: 

At SeekOut, pay equity is at the heart of our compensation philosophy and approach. Our goal is to provide a transparent, fair and rewarding environment where team members are equitably compensated for substantially similar work, feel supported, and ultimately choose to grow their careers here at SeekOut.  To ensure fairness for new hires and existing team members, we factor in an individual's unique skills and experience, market data, and the internal equity of the team.   

Base Salary Hiring Range: $145,000-$170,000 annually. This position will work with our Seattle office and our India office.

SeekOut offers an industry-leading benefits package which includes: 

• Health benefits including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, health savings and flexible spending accounts  

• Stock Options  

• Stipends for home office, education, and wellness  

• Flexible paid time off  

• Company paid holidays, including Juneteenth and Indigenous People’s Day 

• Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents 

• Retirement plan with company match 

This position requires U.S. work authorization and is not eligible for sponsorship.

Our Dedication to a Diverse Workforce: 

SeekOut condemns discrimination, racism, and racial injustice in all forms. Committed to attracting and retaining a diverse staff, SeekOut will honor your experiences, perspectives, and unique identity. Together, we strive to create and maintain working and learning environments that are inclusive, equitable and welcoming. We are accelerating our efforts through our products and policies to take action and advance definitive, measurable policies and practices that eliminate racism and discrimination.     

SeekOut is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/seekout-senior-product-designer-remote
